verdict.rationale: The Grok Bot docs state that routines can be started from an event, such as a Slack message or a GitHub notification. That event trigger is only available through Cursor account integrations and gets a single brief mention. Scheduled routines (time-based) and Auto Review/Always-allow approval rules (permission gating) are separate capabilities and do not count as event-triggered automation. Missing for 10: documentation of how users define event rules and conditions, event sources beyond Cursor-linked Slack/GitHub, native event triggers without a Cursor account, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered routines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Cursor account integrations can start a routine from an event, such as a Slack message or a GitHub notification.
